svg.title: Option+Tab switcher with one tile per window
svg.desc: A cartoon Mac desktop shows the DogBar switcher with five tiles: two Safari windows, Notes, Terminal and Music. Below the screen, the DogBar dog presses the Option and Tab keys with its front paws.
